caption: The drawing depicts a single porcelain vase centered on a plain, beige or off-white background. The vase is a classic shape with a wide, flared mouth, a rounded body, and a narrow base that sits atop a circular foot. Its surface is mostly a glossy white or very light gray, with highlighted reflections that suggest a smooth, reflective material. There are several decorative elements on the vase: painted floral arrangements with green leaves and pink flowers, primarily in a cluster on the central part of the body and smaller accents toward the lower part and sides. Thin yellow or gold bands outline the edge of the mouth, the narrow neck, and the base, adding a subtle detail to the form. The drawing is rendered in a realistic and detailed style, focusing exclusively on the vase without any additional objects or background elements. The artist's signature, "B.A. Dinsmore," is visible in small text in the lower right corner.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
